title: Add your padlock to a group lockout hasp
instruction: A coworker has locked out this switch with a group hasp. Put your purple padlock through any free hole of the hasp and snap it shut. Do not move or remove the coworker's yellow padlock.
context: In a group lockout every worker adds their own padlock to a hasp on the switch handle, and the equipment stays de-energised as long as any one lock remains; a second worker must lock on without disturbing the locks already there, and the lock only protects them if it alone keeps the hasp shut.
setup: Positions are from the arm bases (x: cm in front of the bases; y: cm left of the midline between them, which are 61 cm apart; heights above the table top). Table: the station table. Switch: a grey steel enclosure standing on the table (a plain box 12 cm deep, 25 cm wide, 44 cm tall, standing in for the side of a Square D HU361-class heavy-duty safety switch), fixed, its handle wall facing the robot and turned 30 degrees toward the right arm; on that wall a 10 cm steel lever (1.1 x 1.6 cm, red 3 cm grip at its end) on a pivot 32.7 cm above the table points up at OFF and turns 90 degrees toward the right to ON, with an over-centre detent (1.0 N·m to push it over); its 11 mm square lock-off hole, 5 cm below the pivot, lines up with an 11 mm hole in a fixed 3 mm steel ear only at OFF. Hasp: a Master Lock 420 scissor hasp (steel, red vinyl-coated tail; 25 mm inside jaw diameter, 11.4 cm long, 4.4 cm wide, six lock holes in 2 columns 2.2 cm apart and 3 rows 1.6 cm apart, holes taken as 8 mm square), its jaw ring through the handle's and the ear's holes, hanging from them: ring centre 26.2 cm in front of the bases on the midline, 25.6 cm above the table, bottom row of holes 17.2 cm above the table, the plane of the jaws turned 30 degrees counterclockwise (seen from above) from the robot's forward direction. Coworker's lock: a yellow Master Lock 410YLW Zenex padlock (thermoplastic body 38 x 19 x 44 mm, 6.35 mm steel shackle, 38 mm vertical clearance, 100 g) with a red 3.5 x 5 cm danger tag hanging below it, locked through the wall-side hole of the bottom row. Robot's lock: a purple Master Lock 410PRP of the same size and mass, unlocked with its shackle popped up 16 mm, lying on its 38 x 44 mm side on a pedestal, its shackle pointing toward the hasp. Pedestal: a grey steel column 1.2 x 3.8 cm, 13.8 cm tall, on a 5 x 6 x 1 cm foot, centred 13.8 cm in front of the bases and 9.0 cm left of the midline. Both arms start at the ready pose with their grippers open. One fixed layout, as in the screenshot.
scoring: The score is the highest level reached. 0.25: the purple padlock has moved at least 1 cm from its place on the pedestal. 0.5: the tip of its short shackle leg is within 12 mm of the centre of a tail hole other than the coworker's. 0.75: the short leg passes through both jaws at such a hole. 1.0: the shackle is snapped shut through such a hole, 2 s after both grippers are first at least 6 cm from the purple padlock, it holds by itself: a reviewer removes the coworker's padlock, pries the hasp's tails apart with 0.3 N·m about the rivet (6 N on a spring scale hooked through a free tail hole, 5 cm from the rivet) for 1.5 s, and the jaws open less than 10 degrees; then pushes the handle toward ON with 1.5 N·m (15 N on a spring scale at the lever's tip, 10 cm from the pivot) for 1.5 s, and it turns less than 25 degrees. A shut shackle that fails either check stays at 0.75. Score 0 if the coworker's padlock is lifted or pulled more than 1 cm from where it hangs in its hole before the purple shackle is shut (measured against the hasp, so the hasp swinging on the handle does not count), or if before the hold test the hasp's jaws open more than 8 degrees or the handle turns more than 10 degrees toward ON. Otherwise 0.
reset_notes: Unlock the purple padlock with its key, take it off the hasp and lay it back on the pedestal with its shackle open. Unlock the coworker's yellow padlock if it was removed for the hold test, re-hang it locked through the wall-side bottom hole, with its tag. Close the hasp through the handle's lock-off hole and the ear with the handle at OFF. About 2 minutes.
fidelity: PhysX rigid bodies on joints, arms with the station's i2rt gains. Published: hasp jaw/length/width/holes, Master Lock 410 outline. Inferred: hasp plate thickness, hole size/spacing, handle size, 1.0 N·m detent, shackle travel and spring. Simplified: enclosure is a plain box; lever points up at OFF; box/segment colliders; shackle latches by a catch, no key; coworker lock one rigid body; hold test applied in sim after recording. Details in README.
